The release notes for this cycle cover three separate areas of the codebase. First, the scheduler gained a small fairness fix so that a starved worker no longer waits behind an unbounded queue of higher-priority tasks. Second, the configuration loader now reports a clearer error when a table is misspelled, instead of silently falling back to its default value. Third, the documentation was reorganized so that the module map lives next to the architecture overview rather than several pages away. None of these changes touch the on-disk format, so no migration step is required. Operators upgrading from the previous release should simply reinstall the binary and restart any long-running supervision loops at their own convenience.
